senses.gloss: घट mfn. intently occupied or busy with (loc.), Pāṇ. v, 2, 35
= घटा यस्यास्ति, g. अर्श-आदि
घट m. a jar, pitcher, jug, large earthen water-jar, watering-pot, Mn. viii, xi; Yājñ. iii, 144; AmṛtUp.; MBh. &c.
the sign Aquarius, VarBṛS.
a measure = 1 Droṇa (or = 20 Droṇas, W.), Aṣṭāṅg. v, 6, 28; ŚārṅgS. i, 28
the head, MBh. i, 155, 38, Sch.
a part of a column, VarBṛS. liii, 29
a peculiar form of a temple, lvi, 18 and 26
an elephant's frontal sinus, L.
a border, L.
(= कुम्भ॑) suspending the breath as a religious exercise, L.
(along with कर्पर cf. -कर्पर) N. of a thief, Kathās. lxiv, 43
घटा f. (gaṇas अर्श-आदि, सिध्मादि and पिच्छादि) effort, endeavour, L.
an assembly, L.
a number, collection, assemblage, BhP. iii, 17, 6; Kpr. vii, 11/12
a troop (of elephants) assembled for martial purposes, Mālatīm. v, 19; VarBṛS. xliii; Śiś. i, 64; Kathās.; Rājat.
justification (˚टाम्-√ अट्, ‘to have one's self justified by another’), Bhadrab. iv
(perhaps ˚ट, m.) a kind of drum
a sweet citron, L.
घट्ट m. a, Ghaṭ, quay or landing-place, bathing-place, steps by a river-side &c., ferry, L. (cf. RTL. p. 435 & 518 f.)
घट्टा f. a kind of metre
घाट mfn. (√ घट्) ‘working on’, see दन्त-
= घाटा (or ˚टे) यस्यास्ति (or ˚स्य स्तस्) g. अर्श-आदि (not in Kāś.)
घाट n. management of an elephant, Gal.
घाट m. for घट (a pot), Hariv. 16117 (C)
the nape or back of the neck, cervical ligament, L.
घाटा f. id., Car. i, 17, 17; Suśr. vi, 25, 11 (cf. g. अर्श-आदि) (cf. कर-.)
घाटा f. a pot (cf. घट), Car.
घटी f. a water-jar, Prab. ii, 7/8
(also ˚टि, q.v.; cf. ˚टी-घट) a period of time (= 24 minutes) Sch. on Yājñ. ii, 100-102 and on Sūryas. i, 25
the Ghārī or Indian clock (plate of iron or mixed metal on which the hours are struck), L.
a particular procession, PSarv. (cf. दुर्-, भद्र-.)
घटी f. of ˚ट, q.v.
1. घटि f. = ˚टी, q.v., Uṇ. iv, 117, Sch.
2. घटि in comp. for ˚टिन्.
घट्टी f. a small or inferior landing-place, W. (cf. अर-.)

घट—कञ्चुकि n. an immoral rite practised by Tāntrikas and Śāktas (in which the bodices of different women are placed in a receptacle and the men present at the ceremony are allowed to take them out one by one and then cohabit with the woman to whom each bodice belongs), Āgamapr.
घट—कर्कट-ताल m. (in music) a kind of measure.
घट—कर्पर m. N. of the author of a highly artificial poem called after him (also author of the Nītisāra and mentioned as one of the 9 gems of king Vikramāditya's court)
घट—कर्पर n. the fragments of a pot, Ghaṭ.; Pañcat.
N. of Ghaṭa-karpara's poem
घट—कर्पर—कुलक-वृत्ति f. N. of a Comm. on the preceding.
घट—कार m. a potter, VarBṛS. xv, 1; Laghuj. ix, 7.
घट—कृत् m. id., VarBṛS. xvi, 29.
घट—ग्रह m. a water-bearer, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 9, Vārtt. 1.
घट—घातिनी f. ‘jar-destroyer’, a kind of bird, Gal.
घट—जन्मन् m. ‘jar-born’, Droṇa, Gal.
घट-जानु mfn. having knees swollen like jars, Bcar.
घट—जानुक m. ‘having pot-shaped knees’, N. of a Ṛṣi, MBh. ii, 4, 13 (वर-ज्˚ C).
घट—तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
घट—दासी f. a bawd, L.
घट—पुच्छ m. ‘pot-tailed’, a kind of rice, Gal.
घट—प्रक्षयण m. ‘jar-destroyer’, N. of a man, Kāṭh. xvii, 17.
घट—भव m. ‘jar-born’, Agastya, ŚāṅkhGṛ., Sch.
घट—भेदनक an instrument used in making pots, Buddh.; L.
घट—योनि m. = -भव, BrahmaP. ii, 17.
घट—राज m. a large water-jar, L.
घट—शोधन-कारक n. ‘cleaning the water-jar’, a collective N. for 6 actions of an ascetic (धौती, वस्ती, नेती, त्राटक, नौलिक and कपालभाती), Haṭhapr. ii, 23 f.
घट—श्रोत्र m. ‘pot-eared’, Kumbha-karṇa, RāmatUp.
घट—सृञ्जय m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. vi, 371.
घट—स्थापन n. placing a water-pot as a type of Durgā (essential part of various Tāntrika ceremonies), Vratapr.
घटाटोप m. a covering for a carriage or any article of furniture, W.
घटाभ m. ‘resembling a pot’, N. of a Daitya, Hariv. 12698 (vv.ll. कट्˚ and घण्ट्˚).
घटाभिधा f. ‘named after (i.e. resembling) a jar’, a round kind of gourd, L.
घटार्गल-यन्त्र n. a kind of diagram, Tantr.
घटालाबु f. = ˚टाभिधा, L.
घटावस्था f. (probably) = घट, suspending the breath as a religious austerity, Haṭhapr. iv, 35 f.
घटाह्वया f. = ˚टाभिधा, Gal.
घटेश्वर n. N. of a Liṅga.
घटोत्कच m. N. of a son of Bhīma-sena by the Rākṣasī Hiḍimbā, MBh. i, iii; BhP. ix, 22, 29
N. of a Gupta king, Inscr.
घटोत्क˚चान्तक m. ‘slayer of Ghaṭoṭkaca’, Karṇa, L.
घटोदर m. ‘potbellied’, Gaṇeśa, Kathās. lv, 165
N. of one of Varuṇa's attendants, MBh. ii, 366
of a Rākṣasa, R. vi, 84, 12
of a Daitya, Hariv. 12696.
घटोद्भव m. = ˚ट-भ्˚, L.
घटोध्नी (Uṇ. iv, 192) f. (a cow) having a full udder, Ragh. ii, 49.
घटक mfn. accomplishing, Bhartṛ. ii, 66
procuring, iii, 57, Sch.
ready, skilful, Divyāv. xxx, 143
forming a constituent part, Jaim. i, 1, 5, Sch.
घटक m. a pot, jar, Kathās. lvii, 45
a genealogist, Kulad.
a match-maker, negotiator of matrimonial alliances, RTL. p. 377 (cf. घट-दासी)
a tree that produces fruits without apparent flowers, L.
घाटक mfn. = ˚ट See दन्त-
घटिका f. a water-jar, Mṛcch. x, 55 (59); Sāh. iii, 146/147
(घाट्˚), Pañcat.
a period of time (= 24 [or 48 W.] minutes), Sūryas.; BhP. v, 21, 4 and 10; HYog. iii, 63, Sch. on Jyot. (YV) 25 and 40 f.; Tantr.
(= कला, KātyŚr. ii, 1, 1 and 17, Sch.)
the Ghārī or Indian clock (see ˚टी), Gol. xi, 8
(= घुट्˚) the ancle, L.
घटिका f. See ˚टक.
घटिका f. of ˚टक, q.v.
घटिक mfn. = घटेन तरत्, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 7, Kāś.
घटिक m. a waterman, W.
घटिक n. the hip, posteriors, L.
घटीका f. = ˚टिका (24 minutes), Kālanirṇ.
घाटिका (इका), f. for घट्˚, q.v.
घाटिका f. See ˚टक.
घाटिक m. = घाण्ट्˚, q.v.
घटन n. (= ˚टा, L.) connection or union with (instr. or in comp.), Vikr. ii, 15 (v.l.), Kathās. xxiv, 231
घटन nf. procuring, finding, Kathās. cxviii, 197
making, effecting, forming, fashioning, bringing about, Dhūrtas. i, 7; Kathās. cxxiii, 140; HYog. iii, 102.
घटन m. an actor, L.
a wicked or shameless person, L.
घटना f. exertion, motion, acting, manner of acting, VarBṛS. l, 1; Pañcat.; Kathās. cxxii, 33
striving after, being occupied or busy with (loc. or in comp.), Śāntiś. ii, 20 (= Nāg. iv, 2), Sāh. iv, 14/v (इषु-, ‘shooting an arrow’)
taking effect, answering, accomplishment, (˚नां-√ या, ‘to take effect, succeed’, Rājat. iv, 365; ˚नां-√ नी, to effect, accomplish, Siṃhās.)
connection, union with (in comp.), Sāh. iii, 226/227
(= ˚ट) a troop (of elephants), L.
a literary composition, viii, 7
a work consisting of (in comp.), Vcar. vi, 33
घट्टन n. pushing, touching, rubbing or striking together, Hariv. 14581; Ragh. xi, 71; Kathās. lxxii, 42
stirring round, MārkP. xii, 38
घट्टना f. (? for घटना) going, moving, practice, business, means of living, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 107, Vārtt. 1.
घटयितव्य mfn. to be shut (a hole), Pañcat.
घटाल mfn. fr. ˚टा, g. सिध्मादि (cf. घाट्˚.)
घाटल See ˚टाल.
घाटाल mfn. having a neck or a part thinner than the rest, Suśr. ii, 9, 8 (˚टल, Bhpr. vii, 58, 7) (cf. घट्˚.)
घटि—ं-धम m. ‘pot-blower’, a potter, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 29; Pat.
घटि—ं-धय mfn. one who drinks a pitcherful, ib.
घटि—यन्त्र See ˚टी-य्˚.
घटी—यन्त्र n. the buckets of a well or any machine for raising water, MārkP. (once metrically ˚टि-य्˚), Vcar. viii, 33; Kuval. 46 (cf. अर-घट्ट)
a kind of machine to indicate the time with the help of water, Sarvad. xv, 314; Gol. xi, 8, Sch.
diarrhoea, Bhpr. vii, 16, 24.
घटि—घट m. N. of Śiva, Hariv. 14884 (cf. घटिन्.)
घटी—घट in comp. and ifc. smaller and larger pots, Hariv. 3415; MārkP. viii, 205.
घटिक—लग्न n. ?, Tantr.
घटिका—मण्डल n. the equatorial circle, Āryabh. iv, 19, Sch.
घटिका—यन्त्र n. = ˚टी-य्˚, Pañcat. iv, 1, 8/9 (v.l. घाट्˚).
घटिका—लवण n. a kind of salt, Npr.
घटित mfn. planned, devised, attempted, W.
happened, occurred, W.
connected with, involving (ifc.), Jaim. i, 1, 5, Sch.
shut, Hcar. v, 96
produced, effected by, made, made of (in comp.), Pañcat. &c.
घट्टित mfn. rubbed, touched, shaken, MBh. vii; Hariv.; R. &c.
pressed down, smoothed, MBh. xiv, 2521
(for घटित) shut, Divyāv. ii, 92 and 95
घट्टिता f. a particular way of beating a drum.
घटित—त्व n. connection with, involving (ifc.), Jaim. i, 3, 32, Sch.
घटिन् m. ‘having a water-jar’, the sign Aquarius, Horāś.
N. of Śiva, MBh. xii, 10419.
घटिल mfn. fr. ˚टा, g. पिच्छादि.
घटी—कर m. = -कार, Divyāv.
घटी—कार m. = ˚ट-क्˚, Vop. xxv, 45
घटी—कारी f. a potter's wife, ib.
घटी—ग्रह m. = ˚ट-ग्र्˚, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 9, Vārtt. 1.
घटी—माल m. ‘series of Ghaṭīs’, a period of about 3 hours, Gal.
घटी—यन्त्रक n. a small machine for raising water, Kād. v, 841.
घट्ट—कुटी-प्रभातायित n. ‘acting like the dawn in a hut near a landing-place’, forcing an entrance, Sarvad. xiii, 123.
घट्ट—गा f. N. of a river, L.
घट्ट—जीविन् m. ‘living on a landing-place’, a ferryman (commonly Pāṭuni, son of a washerman by a Vaiśya woman; ‘an attendant at a landing-place, taking care of the clothes of the bathers &c.’, W.)
घट्टानन्द m. N. of a metre.
घट्टितृ mfn. (for घटितृ) fut. p. one who is about to exert himself or to take great pains, MBh. v, 5890.
घाट—कर्करी f. = घाटरी, ŚāṅkhŚr. xvii, 3, 12.
घाटरी f. a kind of lute, 15 f. (cf. अपघाटिला, अवघटरिका, आघाट.)
घाटलिका f. id., Sāy. on RV. x, 146, 2.
